title: Tenant Snapshot Inspector: Network Path & Cost-aware Rollout Widgets
creator: Aisha Thompson
description: Design a compact, interactive Tenant Snapshot Inspector card for the Private/VPC Console that surfaces critical network and cluster state along with cost attribution and rollout controls. The card is intended for tenant operators and SREs to get a fast single-pane view during upgrades and incident triage: visual network path, per-hop latency and egress cost estimates, cluster health badges, canary node status, and one-click actions (open packet-replay, start canary rollback, open upgrade impact simulator). Success metrics: reduce mean triage time by 30% in trials, and lower accidental upgrade rollbacks by surfacing cost/latency trade-offs before action. Constraints: keep card to single row in the tenant list and expandable detail panel, support editions with restricted telemetry (privacy mode), and maintain <200ms hover interactions for tooltips on average.
tasks: Finalize collapsed card layout and priority ordering for badges
Add privacy-mode variant that hides cost estimates and IP-level details
Implement hover microinteraction spec for path hop tooltips
Wireframe expandable detail panel with packet-replay link and upgrade impact simulator CTA
Coordinate with ENG to surface telemetry endpoints and RBAC checks
decisions: Keep primary card to single row with three primary zones: summary badges (left), network path minimap (center), cost/rollout actions (right)
Show cost estimates as ranges and label 'estimated' to comply with non-guaranteed billing data
Default to hiding packet-level details unless tenant telemetry is enabled (privacy-mode off)
Provide an inline canary status pill with color-driven states and accessible text alternatives
review_feedback: PM (Lena Park): 'Love the compactness, please surface the last successful canary timestamp in the collapsed view.'
Eng (Ravi Singh): 'Need an API contract for cost attribution; if not available, show a link to cost explorer instead.'
Security (Marta Ivanov): 'Ensure packet-replay link is gated by RBAC and appears only for operators with forensic role.'
Design Review (Priya Nair): 'Microinteraction feels heavy on hover; consider delaying tooltip by 120ms and add keyboard focus states.'

ui_notes: Collapsed view must prioritize three color-accessible badges (health, canary-status, upgrade-pending)
Network minimap is a condensed SVG path with hoverable hop nodes that reveal latency and estimated egress cost
Cost widget shows 'Estimated egress' with low/medium/high bands and a link to open the cost explorer filtered to tenant
Rollout button opens a small contextual menu: Start canary | Abort canary | Open impact simulator
All interactive elements must have 44px touch targets on mobile and keyboard focus outlines for accessibility
accessibility_considerations: Provide text equivalents for all color states (e.g., 'Canary: healthy, last success 2026-03-09 14:12 UTC')
Tooltips must be dismissible via Escape and not rely on hover alone
Ensure contrast ratios meet AA for small text in badges; use icons + text to avoid color-only meanings
Provide aria-live region updates for state changes when canary transitions occur while a user has the card expanded
